title: holosteum glutinosum subsp. liniflorum
intro: Holosteum glutinosum subsp. liniflorum, commonly known as sticky chickweed, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Holosteum glutinosum subsp. liniflorum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to relieve coughs, reduce swelling, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
